Nepal Observes National Mourning After Flash Flood Tragedy

Nepal observed a national day of mourning on the 13th day following a flash flood tragedy, adhering to traditional Hindu mourning practices. The observance marked the traditional 13th day after the disaster, a period often associated with remembrance and final rites in Hindu tradition. The event was marked across the country.
